name: kanban_depend
description: Say a card is waiting on another, or that it no longer is. A card whose dependencies are not finished is shown as blocked rather than being forbidden to move.
llm_description: Add or remove a card dependency: op depend_add or depend_remove, depends_on = id it waits on. Unfinished deps show the card as blocked but don't block moving it.

depends_on.description: Id of the card this one waits on

room.description: Board room name; omit for the default 'board' room
